catalogue_metadata.extraction_method: PDF text extraction followed by source-row normalization
rules: Course codes and credits are retained as printed where unambiguous.
Conflicting numeric credits for the same code are withheld and listed in credit_discrepancies.
Elective/project allocations are represented as pending_configuration slots, not invented course identities.
EE 2023 is kept as a separate historical curriculum.
EE current curriculum remains pending a newer source document.
known_source_issues: Some PDFs omit codes for named courses; those rows require manual code confirmation.
EEE PDF contains two Semester IV table variants.
Some tables use legacy or placeholder course codes.
Course code-less elective/project choices depend on individual student selection.
EE205T has unresolved 3-versus-6 credit discrepancy across source curricula.
EE302C is version-specific: 3 credits in historical EE 2023 and 6 credits in the 2025 source curricula.
credit_resolution_policy: User-confirmed canonical credit decisions are applied consistently across all branches.
Pass/No Pass courses are represented with credits 0 and credit_type PP/NP.
Historical curriculum versions remain separate and may retain version-specific values.
Unresolved conflicts retain credits null and pending_verification status; no value is guessed.
catalogue_metadata.elective_placeholder_policy: Each source-listed elective slot is represented by one generic Elective placeholder, retaining its department-specific semester and source-listed credits.
